tasks.title: Repo-version-aware ts_exports diff: detect old-API removals across multiple major versions
tasks.acceptance: When depfix scan finds call sites for a provider AND the repo's lockfile resolves a semver version for that SDK, depfix compares that installed version's TypeScript exports against the latest version's exports. Symbols that (a) exist in the installed version, (b) are absent from the latest, and (c) match an observed call site, produce a synthetic BreakingChange record so plan/apply can act on them. Verified on: (1) bedilk/depfix-test-sentry-v6-app — sentry.startTransaction must become actionable, (2) bedilk/seed-openai-v3-to-v4 — openai.createChatCompletion must become actionable (if version resolves). make test passes, no regressions.
tasks.notes: ACCEPTED by reviewer round 3. Sub-case B committed (7896cff), mypy fix (export_name→b_name), 24 tests total. make test: 917 passed, lint clean, mypy clean. Non-blocking: double tarball fetch (installed fetched in repo_version_exports_diff then again in sub-case B). Prior: REJECTED rounds 1-2 (sub-case B not committed, mypy error).
